title: Have you used Angie's list? | Houzz Forum

facts.fact: A forum commenter (steve_o) says they have subscribed to Angie's List for about 8 years.
facts.quote: I've subscribed to AL for about 8 years now and I re-up happily.

facts.fact: A forum commenter says that in about 8 years of Angie's List use they hired only one 'dud' from the List, a handyman.
facts.quote: In that length of time, I've hired only one "dud" off the List, and that was a handyman.

facts.fact: A forum commenter says Angie's List charges a yearly subscription fee, but the page does not state the amount.
facts.quote: the yearly subscription fee is much less than I'd pay to fix a crummy job

facts.fact: A Houzz forum user reported paying $75 for 2 hours of handyman work (french doors hung) through Angie's List Big Deals.
facts.quote: I have had 2 hours handyman work for $75 (french doors hung)

facts.fact: A Houzz forum user reported paying $600 to have 3 rooms' walls painted (500 sf max, 2 coats) through Angie's List Big Deals.
facts.quote: 3 rooms walls painted (500 sf max, 2 coats) for $600

facts.fact: A Houzz forum user reported paying $200 for whole-house air duct cleaning through Angie's List Big Deals.
facts.quote: whole house air duct cleaning the proper way for $200

facts.fact: A Houzz forum user reported paying $175 for a whole-house surge suppressor installation through Angie's List Big Deals.
facts.quote: whole house surge suppressor installed for $175

facts.fact: A Houzz forum user reported using about 12-13 different contractors over three years through Angie's List.
facts.quote: I've used the services of about 12 -13 different contractors in the last three years

facts.fact: The sponsored LaBella Associates, PC listing shows an average rating of 5 out of 5 stars based on 4 reviews.
facts.quote: Average rating: 5 out of 5 stars 4 Reviews
